dct_title_s: Novissima et Accuratissima TOTIUS AMERICÆ DESCRIPTIO
dct_description_sm: per JOHANEM OGILUIUM Cosmographum Regium [John Ogilby].
Based on Visscher map; California as an island with flat northern coast. "Strate Anian" and "Anian" to north.
Engraved by: F. Lamb, Sculp (lower right).
Figured title cartouche in lower left; Top left cartouche mentions Anthony Ashley; both fully colored.
